evidence.note: The Fragmentation 3 values region and avoid-region force or avoid a break between CSS Regions. CSS Regions has no implementation in the current Chrome, Firefox or Safari (Blink removed it in 2014; BCD css.properties.flow-into has no support in any of them), so every browser parses these values and none acts on them. BCD has no entry of their own, so css-compat.json gave them the support of the property.

The Text Decoration 3 value blink lets conforming user agents not blink the text, and the current Chrome, Firefox and Safari parse it and never blink: the declaration changes nothing on the page.

evidence.source: tests/e2e/css-support.spec.ts in Chrome 153.0.8010.54: CSS.supports('break-before', 'all') is false
evidence.note: The installed Chrome's own parser refuses break-before: all, so a declaration with it is dropped and does nothing on the page; the browser is the truth, whatever the compatibility data says.
